categories.main_business_segments: J-OIL MILLS, INC. operates primarily in two business segments: the Oils & Fats Business, which includes the manufacturing, processing, and sales of household and commercial edible oils and meals; and the Specialty Food Business, which covers the production and sale of plant-based foods, food ingredients, and specialty food materials. The company also has a minor segment engaged in real estate leasing and other activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced oil extraction, refining, and processing technologies for edible oils, as well as proprietary techniques for developing functional starches and plant-based food materials. It emphasizes environmentally friendly packaging (e.g., Smart Green Pack), oil products with reduced splatter and usage, and solutions that extend product shelf life and reduce food loss. R&D also focuses on health-oriented ingredients and sustainable production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include food manufacturers, foodservice companies, bakeries, confectionery producers, and wholesalers, as well as general consumers through retail channels. Major end markets are the food processing industry, foodservice sector, and retail consumers, with significant sales to large clients such as Ajinomoto Co., Inc. and the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations (ZEN-NOH).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are in Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales and assets. Internationally, it has a presence in ASEAN countries (notably Thailand and Malaysia) and North America, with overseas subsidiaries and affiliates supporting sales expansion in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: J-OIL MILLS operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain, sourcing raw materials (soybeans, rapeseed, etc.) globally, processing them into oils, meals, and specialty food ingredients, and supplying these products to food manufacturers, foodservice providers, and retailers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high value-added and environmentally friendly products, strengthening overseas business (especially in ASEAN and North America), and driving innovation in plant-based and health-oriented food materials. R&D focuses on sustainability (e.g., sustainable procurement, CO2 reduction), food safety, health benefits, and next-generation technologies such as sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) from non-edible plant seeds.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of edible oils, meals, and specialty food products to B2B and B2C customers. Additional income is derived from real estate leasing and, to a lesser extent, licensing and joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Nisshin OilliO Group, Fuji Oil Holdings, and other large Japanese and global edible oil and specialty food manufacturers. J-OIL MILLS is positioned as a leading integrated oils and specialty food company in Japan, with a focus on innovation, sustainability, and high-value-added products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥230.8 billion, with operating profit of ¥8.6 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥7.0 billion. The company has a stable financial base, with a self-financing ratio of 62.2%, and is transitioning from structural reform to a growth phase, aiming for further profit and overseas expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: J-OIL MILLS differentiates itself through its commitment to 'deliciousness × health × low environmental impact,' offering products that address both consumer needs and social issues such as sustainability and health. Unique offerings include environmentally friendly packaging, oils that reduce usage and splatter, long-lasting oils for foodservice, and plant-based food solutions, all underpinned by a strong focus on innovation and ESG management.
